notes: R-ID map aligned to 03-requirements.md (R-19 Audit, R-20 AI Draft-Only, R-21 Telemetry, R-22 Release Version + Experiment Exposure, R-23 Structured Feedback, R-24 Manager View, R-25 Data Health). Status rule: 'done' chỉ khi không còn P1 mở chạm tính năng đó và notes không tự khai hạng mục còn hoãn. F-025…F-038 là đề xuất/di trú từ 03-requirements §10 (R-29…R-41) và discovery QA-01…59 — chưa duyệt vào LVP, không tự mở rộng PH3. CE-1/CE-2/PM-1/MM-1/ID-1/ID-2/LG-1 vẫn BLOCKED-BY. Cập nhật tại 6a98fdf (2026-10-27): cả 3 cạnh P1 còn mở tại 1b72b61 (P1-1 colon collision, P1-2 per-item RBAC & multi-handoff view retention, P1-4 action-proof & absent/conflicted guard) đã đóng và verify qua 243/243 tests + 60/60 HTTP smoke checks.

features.name: Pilot Workspace Isolation
features.notes: PH1 shell done (workspace-store 10 tests, synthetic segregation). 2026-10-07: DB isolation verified on PG16 + pilot cross-user 403/cross-workspace 404 live HTTP; workspaceId/owner server-derived (QA-32). P1-fix round (closed at 6a98fdf): envelope idempotency scoped to workspace via injective JSON tuple JSON.stringify([workspaceId, connection, externalRecordId]) (F-005/migration 004), demo header sandboxed to demo:<name> and opt-in (was able to address any tenant), in-memory audit history no longer leaks other leads of the same workspace. PH6 pilot pending.

features.name: Authentication
features.notes: 2026-10-07: stub auth enforced on pilot HTTP surface — 401 unauthenticated + demo header verified live (R-02). Auth resolves BEFORE body validation so 401 never leaks the input schema; demo path is sandboxed (demo:<name>) and opt-in via DEMO_WORKSPACES=true (default off = fail closed). NOT real auth: unsigned Bearer dev-only (AUTH_DEV_UNSIGNED_TOKENS), no global guard; credential model (invite/password/IdP) vẫn QA-28/PM-1 open.

features.name: Role-Based Access
features.notes: Frozen boundary I-09 done (lead-scoped). 2026-10-07 → 2026-10-27 (6a98fdf): handoff recipient view+accept verified; unrelated user 403, cross-workspace 404 qua HTTP thật (không mở rộng role). P1-2 CLOSED at 6a98fdf: view/accept/mutation là ba quyền tách biệt — view = owner + activeWorkRecipients(state) + manager/admin cùng workspace; accept = đúng recipient được gán trên work item đó (item.actor === actor, 403 NOT_ASSIGNED_RECIPIENT); mutation = CURRENT owner VÀ đúng item.actor === actor trên item đã accepted/open (403 NOT_OWNER / NOT_ASSIGNED_RECIPIENT); manager/admin không được nới thêm. Manager view scope vẫn workspace-wide tạm — QA-58/PM-1 pending RFC.

features.name: Manual/Synthetic Lead Import
features.notes: Manual adapter done (12 tests incl. P1-1 workspace-scoping + colon-collision regressions, raw preserved). CSV template/preview/row-level validation (QA-11) pending PH5. 2026-10-07 P1-4: ingest bodies validated at the HTTP boundary (400 INPUT_INVALID) before the adapter is reached.

features.name: Versioned Inbound Envelope
features.notes: envelope 13 tests, raw immutability done. Provider extension deferred to PH4 (Q-03/Q-04). P1-1 CLOSED at 6a98fdf (2026-10-27): idempotencyKey encoded as injective JSON tuple JSON.stringify([workspaceId, connection, externalRecordId]) so colons inside workspaceId/connection never collide across tenants in either InMemoryPilotStore or PgPilotStore; migration 004 quarantines unscoped legacy rows and refuses to guess on multi-workspace conflicts.

features.name: Lead Create + Stable ID
